name: Motlow State Community College
oos_note: Public JUCO (TN Board of Regents). Out-of-state (non-resident) tuition & fees $17,722 vs in-state $4,738 from federal College Scorecard/IPEDS 'latest' data (approx 2023-24 reporting year). Official mscc.edu and tbr.edu tuition pages returned HTTP 403 to automated fetch, so used federal government source. Note: known in-state benchmark ($5,064) is a slightly more recent figure; the non-resident number here is the most recent officially verifiable value.
